test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box can be made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58da745ed45b1535f93a44f401136cc7829d6bbfec52e71b569f956aff83854d.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/129eba29e2223bc1209a79222b288e5e77faa1a41503f0e228a36d4136e46340.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• 1 → 2
 
• 4 → 6
 
• 7 → 5

Therefore,

 
• Option(1) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0c908d8b6e0d02e171245e07242f58d58b7187c162c6d81d2a59b3f3361e496.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 1 and 2 are one of the opposite pairs)
 
• **Option(2) → ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4251dabf1d52e81cb90294aee6629299a34645f98f41ba99811a573b8197b58.png] **⇒ **can be formed** as a box from the given sheet (As 2, 4 and 7 are one numbers of each opposite pairs)**
 
• Option(3) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8228b0e58106c5b9bf2ffe834c93bf6acc36d5e5dcff895c2d783feadc8a712d.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 7 and 5 are one of the opposite pairs) 
 
• Option(4) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb1296e0f14368a9b1a0ff81f681e2c9a5aa4d0b78f9e648c854c39e7eecfd5f.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a box from the given sheet (As 4 and 6 are one of the opposite pairs)

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
